skills.name: Overhead Slam
skills.note: Your #1 damage source; with Rage Burst and Lunge Stance it's effectively always up. 16 removes the cooldown, 20 adds the guaranteed crit.

skills.name: Rending Blow
skills.note: Second-biggest damage and your mana engine. Mobile pick at 8, +50 MP on crit at 16, +12% single target at 20.

skills.name: Ruinous Blow
skills.note: Big nuke that grants Prepare for Battle (+20% PvE damage, 20s).

skills.name: Sword Aura Rampage
skills.note: Only hits Staggered targets; at 16 every hit takes 1s off all cooldowns, stigmas included.

skills.name: Leaping Slam
skills.note: Main gap-closer; 3s of Prepare for Battle before Ruinous Blow extends it.

skills.name: Rush Strike
skills.note: Dodge into a gap-close. Take the Stamina pick over -10s cooldown.

skills.name: Mocking Blade
skills.note: Emergency heal: 15% HP absorbed from bosses.

skills.name: Ankle Slice
skills.note: Backup closer. Skip the Ankle Smash chain.

skills.name: Crushing Wave
skills.note: Too slow for bosses; AoE and self-heal on trash.

skills.name: Keen Strike
skills.note: Basic attack: +20% MP and -1s Ruinous Blow cooldown per hit. Stop holding it once Overhead Slam and Rending Blow are 16.

skills.name: Aerial Snare
skills.note: Optional, bosses only (aLuckyRO): +100% damage to CC-immune targets and the Forced Fall chain. Give it its own key.

skills.name: Defiance
skills.note: CC break, only if you have points to spare.

stigmas.name: Lunge Stance
stigmas.note: Level 20 cuts all cooldowns on crits. First stigma to max.

stigmas.name: Focused Block
stigmas.note: Guaranteed parry; every block triggers Experienced Counterstrike's party buff. Two uses in a row at 5.

stigmas.name: Rage Burst
stigmas.note: Triggers Overhead Slam for 10s, +10% PvE Damage Boost, -10% boss Attack; -15s cooldown at 5.

stigmas.name: Zikel's Blessing
stigmas.note: Default 4th slot: +20% Attack, +10% PvE Damage Boost at 10.

stigmas.name: Lifestealing Blade
stigmas.note: Replaces Zikel's Blessing: Predation on the party. Only worth it at 20. Blade Toss (-30% boss Defense) is the semi-tank alternative.

passives.name: Attack Preparation
passives.note: Flat PvE Damage Boost, Defense and Accuracy. No conditions.

passives.name: Experienced Counterstrike
passives.note: Front damage at all times, plus a 20s party PvE Damage Boost on every block.

passives.name: Murderous Burst
passives.note: Every 5 hits: AoE burst + crit damage.

passives.name: Destructive Impulse
passives.note: Bonus damage on Staggered targets; after the main passives.

passives.name: Protection Armor
passives.note: Trap: reroll gear and cards that roll it.

arcana.Chalice: Vigor — whatever is still short of 20
arcana.Set: 4-piece Primal Vigor; 2-piece Magic Armor only if MP runs dry

daevanionNote: Guide priority: blue nodes for Overhead Slam, Rending Blow and Ruinous Blow first, then the orange nodes, then stats. Azphel is PvP only.

ludra.name: Abyssal Forge: Ludra
ludra.note: 10-player Sanctuary raid, four level-75 bosses. Entry needs level 45 and item level 2,800 for Normal, 3,000 for Hard; it drops item-level-102 gear. Groups usually also ask for a combat-power number.
ludra.warning: The raid was temporarily removed after Early Access and returns on November 4, 2026.

phases.title: Finish the level phase
do: Main story to 45; item level 1,000 is needed to finish the story (Abyss visit).
Side quests, sealed dungeons (map '?'), strongholds and the 5 daily quests.
Weapon to about +10; amulet +10 and morph it blue.

phases.title: Permanent upgrades first
do: Belt: stronghold scrolls to +10, then craft it up to legendary — it never gets replaced.
Revelation Amulet: feathers from the world and the Abyss at the monolith, same idea.
Regional quests for accessories, runes and titles; clash runes only to +1.
Daevanion: sealed dungeons and regional quests give the crystals; Krao Cave and Draupnir open at 700.
Shugo Festival, rifts, daily dungeons.

phases.title: Item-level-70 gear: Vakron and Urugu
do: Goal for 2,100: at least 12 of the 14 main slots at item level 70 (belt, amulet and bracelets don't count).
Farm a mix of both: Vakron bosses always drop gear you can use, Urugu can drop weapons for other classes.
Not crafting a weapon soon? Save 2 pity vouchers for the Urugu weapon — it carries you past 2,100, so you can skip the Fire Temple (Kromede) weapon. Crafting right away? Skip it.
Don't spend 2 vouchers on the Vakron Guard — Horn Den replaces it at 2,100.
Gartua on Immortal Island twice a day: about 1 in 5 for an item-level-70 armor or jewellery piece.
Never skip Nightmare entries and the Ascension Trial each reset (normal difficulty from 1,500).

phases.title: Transcendence 1–2 and the first stones
do: Transcendence 1 at 1,600: run both dungeons once to fill the card slots. Transcendence 2 at 1,900: run both twice for 5 green cards (40 each); a blue or two (60) can push you straight to 2,100.
Card skill lines: Overhead Slam and Ruinous Blow on the Parchment first.
Roll Lesser Manastones on every item-level-70 piece until 1–2 green lines (white +1, green +2). Keep Intermediate stones for item level 86.
Enhance item-level-70 pieces to +10 only if you're short of 2,100. Take the Urugu or a crafted weapon to +15 only if its lines are worth transferring later.
A few points missing? Enhance the bracelets — they stay with you a long time.

phases.title: Item level 86 in every slot
do: Spam Ferocious Horn Den and Fire Temple until every slot is item level 86. Horn Den first: much better armor odds, while Fire Temple can drop weapons for other classes.

Don't open pity chests right away: hold vouchers until 1–2 slots are left, or Substance Morph (500k Kina) the exact piece. Save 3 Horn Den vouchers for the guard (Nocom Guard: 3 vouchers + 2M Kina, about 84 runs) — crafting one costs as much as a weapon.

If you craft one thing, craft the weapon: it rolls 2 more lines than the Fire Temple weapon. Keep the Urugu weapon until it's done. Rings next (extra active-skill lines). A Kromede weapon only transfers into a higher tier (the 102 crafted one).
Crafting procs at 25%: compare the cost with the market price on questlog.gg, and buy if they're close.

Intermediate Manastones (about 35k Kina) in every item-level-86 piece: 15% for a blue line (+3). About 1 blue, 1–2 green and 1–2 white is +7–8 per slot — there's no pity, so don't chase more. Keep Superior stones (about 1M) for item-level-102 gear.
Transcendence 3: only 1–2 runs, to fill empty slots with blue cards or cross 2,500 — save the energy for Transcendence 4.

Arcana rules: grey 20, green 40, blue 60, gold 80 item level, +1 per enhancement level. Feeding a card into a better one keeps 100% of its EXP; +4 to +5 needs 48k EXP, so +4 is the cheap stop. Skip transmutation for now; take strong Divine stats (Time = Combat Speed) over small set bonuses.
Enhance to +11/+12. Cheaper: take a low-tier unique (e.g. Bakarma Hard drops) to +15 at about half the Kina and transfer the levels — this overwrites the target's lines.
Re-roll bad random lines (Evasion, resists) into Might, Combat Speed, Precision; fill every manastone slot.

phases.title: Gold Arcana and amplification
do: Transcendence 4 from 2,500: 6% for a gold card per boss, 3 bosses (about 20% per run). Five gold cards are 400 item level; keep farming for skill lines that take your main skills to 16–20.

Amplification opens at +15: each level is +5 item level. Amp 1 is 66% for 6 Amp Stones (Substance Morph) and about 600k Kina; Amp 2 is 9 stones and about 900k. One piece at +15 Amp 2 beats several pieces at +15.

Amp order: weapon and guard to +15 Amp 2 or more (+1% Damage Boost, +16 Attack per level), then rings and accessories (+0.5%, +18 Attack). That's enough for 2,800. Armor amps only give defense — skip them unless you need the raw item level.

Ascension Trial Extreme opens at 2,500. Krao Cave and Draupnir Hard (2,600) give Ariel fragments for up to 60 item level; route Damage Boost nodes first, then Boss Attack. Sources disagree on worth: JOHNPAL counts 2–3k Combat Power, Fubgun calls it the lowest priority (lots of energy, no gear, 1–2k CP) — run them if you need the raw item level.
Season shop: Talisra Wings (about 250,000 points); titles Guardian of Baran or Artguard; pets to 3 and Genus Insight rolls.

phases.title: Ludra: Normal at 2,800, Hard at 3,000
do: Ludra drops item-level-102 gear: weapons go to +15, Unique armor and accessories have 4 manastone slots — that's where the Superior stones go.
Bosses have Crit Defense, Evasion and Parry (the training dummy has none): aim for about 1,200 Accuracy and 1,200–2,000 Critical Hit.

2,800 to 3,000 is the same plan with more Kina: Amp +2/+3 on more pieces. Hard modes of Urugu, Vakron, Fire Temple and Horn Den are expected to bring two more boards (+60 each), which would make 3,000 much cheaper.
Keep a second stigma preset with Lifestealing Blade 20 for organized parties.

tips.title: Free item level — do these first
do: All Abyss Feathers: +36 item level. Almost no Combat Power, but every entry check (2,100 dungeons, 2,500 Transcendence, 2,600 Hard modes, Ludra) counts item level.
Daevanion points to the 416 cap (476 with Ariel). Run the Shugo Festival whenever you have keys and buy every Daevanion point; in the Nightmare shop, buy all board points before Stigma Shards.
Every sealed dungeon (M → Exploration): +2 board points each. Every regional quest (J → Regional): +1 item level each.
Don't spend Abyss Points on the Azphel board just for item level — it's PvP-only and you need the points for Stigma Shards.

tips.title: Stigma Shards and Abyss Points
do: Stigma Shards are your biggest source of real damage and Combat Power.
Buy shards in the Nightmare Trade Shop and the Shugo shop. In the Shugo shop, take Daevanion crystals up to step 3, finish your stigmas, then buy the expensive crystals.
Supply requests and world-boss trains (Gartua, Kaira, Kashapa): turning in boss armor or accessories pays a lot (over 111k AP for one set).
Weekly Abyss time (outside the open-world Kina cap), sieges every two days and, while your faction holds them, the corridors (25–30k AP each for AoE classes).
Daily Duties and weekly Commands on your main only; Abyss boss platoon tokens morph into weekly AP chests; Battlefield twice a day (1k per match, 3k per win, three wins a week).

tips.title: Soul binding, syncing and skill breakpoints
do: Check the soul-binding lines on every unique you loot, even low-tier and Shugo gear: Combat Speed or Perfect Chance on gloves, Move Speed on boots, Double Chance on cloaks are rare.
Don't bind bad lines to 100% — rolling a new line resets its percentage.
Soul Reset Codex rerolls every line; supply is tiny, so use it only on weapon, guard and rings.
Syncing rerolls one line by eating a unique or a Sync Stone; use bound uniques from alts (server storage) or Shugo events instead of 1.7M Kina market ones.
Maxed soul binding opens a Philosopher Stone slot; roll something common like Attack % — the stone breaks when you transfer or upgrade the item.
Crafted rings and Arcana push main skills to 16 (bottom specialization row) and 20 (third specialization slot).

tips.title: More Combat Power
do: Wings: each has an equipped effect and an owned effect that stays. Collect several; Forest Spirit worn plus Dark Veil owned (1% Damage Boost) is strong before end-game wings.
Pets and Genus give stats to every character on the server, alts included.
Pantheon: statues and boss/event paintings give a lot of Combat Power and Divine stats; the two Shugo Festival artworks are easy Wisdom and Illusion.
Titles (about 5,000 CP) and closet skins (small permanent damage bonuses).
Theostones are under 1% of PvE damage — don't overspend; pick Seal or Stun for PvP.

tips.title: Kina and alts
do: Daily Dungeon tickets share a server-wide bucket: the top Battle Pass on alts funnels extra tickets to your main for enhancement and amplification stones.
Transcendence has its own weekly reward bucket: after 84 Conquest runs, switch to it for full Kina.
When morphing gold materials like Esveta logs, convert Radiant Odal into them — cheaper 90% of the time.
Not rushing Ludra? Sell unbound Amp Stones and Superior Soulstones (about 400k each) while raiders push prices up.

tips.title: Testing your damage
do: Training dummy in front of Safe Haven, Ctrl + X opens the DPS meter. Run 2-minute tests to compare stigmas, skills and gear.
The dummy has no resistances, so real bosses need the Accuracy and Crit above.
